title: Transport of a raw inverse scalar comparison to stage systems
statement: Fix a prime l, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme T with l invertible. Fix stage equivalences FdRationalStageComparison l $\Omega$ T E for every finite coefficient field E [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum]. Use the integral functors I_E, ordinary extension C, completed extension U, specified rational extensions scalar and P, associators and units, RationalFamily and RawComparison of [lem-fd-raw-localization-scalar-coherence], with the shift structures of [def-per-common-stage-shift-structures, def-fd-integral-scalar-shift-structures] and the specified source stage system of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Suppose b:I_E C_{L/E}\cong U_{L/E}I_L is any integral comparison. Suppose a RationalFamily fixes the supplied rational functors and all their shifts, and j:scalar_{L/E} J_L\cong J_E P_{L/E} is a RawComparison commuting with both specified shifts, with both endpoint composites exact. Suppose j has the integral lift Q_L(b^{-1}) followed by the inverse scalar-integral comparison on every integral localization object, its identity-extension value is J_E of the framework unit, and it obeys the three-field inverse cocycle with the specified scalar associators. Then there exist a morphism F of the framework stage system to the PBC stage system and specified shifts on all F.\Phi _E such that F.\Phi _E and all its shifts are heterogeneously equal to the supplied rational equivalences and their shifts, F.\Phi _E is exact, both F.\beta  and its inverse commute with shifts, the inverse identity component of F.\beta  has the same normalized unit value, and the forward integral-lift component of F.\beta  is the scalar-integral comparison followed by Q_L(b). This assertion concerns packaging of given comparisons only; it assumes their existence and their three-field cocycle and does not assert a four-field formula.

proof.text: The specification of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] identifies the source stage-system transitions and associators with the scalar functors and assoc of [lem-fd-raw-localization-scalar-coherence]. Transport j inverse along these equalities. Its supplied three-field inverse cocycle implies the forward coherence equation after cancelling the two component isomorphisms, defining F with beta equal to the transported inverse comparison. RationalFamily fixes its finite functors and their shifts to the supplied stage equivalences, so exactness and both shift squares transfer. The given identity-extension equation transfers to F beta inverse.

proof.text: Invert the given integral-lift component equation. Functoriality sends b inverse to the inverse of Q(b), and inversion reverses the two factors. Thus the forward beta component is the scalar-integral comparison followed by Q(b). The raw object normalizations and their canonical equality casts identify its endpoints. No new comparison existence or four-field assertion is needed.

theorem fdRawScalarComparisonPackaging
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Ω : Type w) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
    [dT : Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim T ≤ n)]
    [iT : Fact (∀ t : T, IsUnit (l : T.presheaf.stalk t))]
    (stage : ∀ E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω, FdRationalStageComparison l Ω T E)
    (b : ∀ {E L : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (h : E ≤ L),
      I l Ω T stage E ⋙ C l Ω T h ≅ U l Ω T h ⋙ I l Ω T stage L)
    (family : RationalFamily l Ω T stage)
    (j : RawComparison l Ω T stage family)
    (hshift : (∀ {E L : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (h : E ≤ L),
        NatTrans.CommShift (j h).hom ℤ ∧ NatTrans.CommShift (j h).inv ℤ ∧
        (scalar l Ω T h ⋙ J l Ω T stage family L).IsTriangulated ∧
        (J l Ω T stage family E ⋙ (P l Ω T).T h).IsTriangulated))
    (hlift : (∀ {E L : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (h : E ≤ L)
        (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) T)
        (K' : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage l Ω T E),
        HEq K' ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) T).obj K) →
        HEq ((j h).hom.app K')
          ((pbcStageLocalization l Ω T L).map ((b h).inv.app K) ≫
            (pbcScalarIntegralComparison l Ω T dT.out iT.out h).inv.app
              ((I l Ω T stage E).obj K))))
    (hunit : (∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω)
        (K : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage l Ω T E),
        HEq ((j (le_refl E)).hom.app K)
          ((J l Ω T stage family E).map
            ((unit l Ω T E).hom.app K))))
    (hcocycle : (∀ {E L M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (h : E ≤ L) (k : L ≤ M)
        (K : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage l Ω T E),
        (j k).hom.app ((scalar l Ω T h).obj K) ≫
          ((P l Ω T).T k).map ((j h).hom.app K) ≫
          ((P l Ω T).assoc h k).hom.app ((J l Ω T stage family E).obj K) =
        (J l Ω T stage family M).map ((assoc l Ω T h k).hom.app K) ≫
          (j (h.trans k)).hom.app K))
    : ∃ (F : StageSystem.Morphism
      (C := GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage l Ω T)
      (D := pbcStageCategory l Ω T)
      (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω T)
      (pbcScalarSystem l Ω T dT.out iT.out))
      (s : ∀ E, (F.Φ E).CommShift ℤ),
      let _ : ∀ E, (F.Φ E).CommShift ℤ := s
      (∀ E, HEq (F.Φ E) (stage E).rational.functor) ∧
      (∀ E (n : ℤ),
    HEq ((F.Φ E).commShiftIso n) ((stage E).rational.functor.commShiftIso n)) ∧
      (∀ {E L : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (h : E ≤ L),
    NatTrans.CommShift (F.β h).hom ℤ ∧ NatTrans.CommShift (F.β h).inv ℤ) ∧
      (∀ E, (F.Φ E).IsTriangulated) ∧
      (∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω)
    (K : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage l Ω T E),
    HEq ((F.β (le_refl E)).inv.app K)
      ((F.Φ E).map
        ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.unitor l Ω T E).hom.app K))) ∧
      (∀ {E L : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (h : E ≤ L)
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) T)
    (K' : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage l Ω T E),
    HEq K' ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) T).obj K) →
    HEq ((F.β h).hom.app K')
      ((pbcScalarIntegralComparison l Ω T dT.out iT.out h).hom.app
          ((stage E).integral.functor.obj K) ≫
        (pbcStageLocalization l Ω T L).map ((b h).hom.app K)))
